motivation: External review: separate the effect of parametric atoms from that of a generic rank-M factorization, cross-validate the validation-selected PSAN-versus-dense comparison, and check the comparison after longer training.
prior_exposure: all round-2 and round-3 test results, including validation-selected PSAN, PSAN-AD0 and matched dense at seeds 42-44 and the MedMNIST+128 benchmarks

controls.lowrank16: PSAN backbone; every filter K = W B with a free complex basis B (16 x 14 x 8) and free W (192 x 16); B and W start from the initial PSAN-AD0 atoms and mixing weights of the same seed, so the initial network equals PSAN-AD0; 9,728 filter parameters per block; no dropout
controls.lowrank10: as lowrank16 with rank 10 (6,080 filter parameters per block, close to the 6,272 of PSAN); basis starts from Morlet-initialized 10-atom banks; non-filter tensors equal PSAN-AD0
controls.fixedatom16: PSAN-AD0 whose atom geometry (mu, log_sigma, rho_raw, theta, log_amp, phi) stays at its Morlet initialization; only the complex mixing weights of the filter are learned

screening.objective: highest best-epoch validation Macro F1; ties use earlier candidate order

outer_cv.fold1: the validation-selected seed-42 finals on the main split (fold 1 test, fold 2 validation)
outer_cv.caveat: settings were selected on the main split, whose validation fold (fold 2) is the test fold of outer fold 2; no setting was selected on any outer test fold

long_training.candidate: c2 (selected setting of all three arms)
long_training.selection: best validation Macro F1 epoch, as in all rounds

common.precision: float32 tensors; CUDA matmul TF32 off; cuDNN convolution TF32 default

statistics.ci: paired percentile bootstrap over test visual groups; crossed group x seed bootstrap across seeds
statistics.outer_cv_summary: per-fold paired bootstrap, and pooled out-of-fold Macro F1 over all 104,037 images with a paired bootstrap over all visual groups
statistics.long_training_note: single seed: intervals reflect test-sample variation only

checkpoint_retention: best.pth kept; resume-only last.pth deleted after a completed run
concurrency: up to two jobs per GPU, shared with other users; wall-clock times are not reported as cost
